info.name: Geek Text API — CEN 4010 Group 9
info.description:
RESTful API collection for the Geek Text online tech bookstore.

Course: CEN 4010 — Principles of Software Engineering
Team: Group 9 — GeekText Architects
Institution: Florida International University

---

**Setup:**
1. Import this collection AND the environment file `GeekTextAPI.postman_environment.json`
2. Select the "Geek Text API — Local" environment from the top-right dropdown
3. Make sure your local server is running: `npm run dev`
4. The `{{baseUrl}}` variable resolves to `http://localhost:3000`

**Sprint 2 Status:**
- ✅ Health Check
- ✅ GET all books
- ✅ GET book by ISBN
- 🔜 All other endpoints (Sprint 3)

**Folder Structure:**
Each folder maps to one team feature. Implemented endpoints are ready to run. Placeholders will return 404 until Sprint 3 implementation.

variable.description: Base URL for local development. Change to staging/production URL when deploying.

item.name: 🏥 Health Check
item.description: Server liveness check. Use this to confirm the API is running before testing any feature endpoints.

request.description:
Quick sanity check that the Express server is alive and responsive.

**Expected response (200 OK):**

```json
  "message": "Geek Text API is running",
  "timestamp": "2026-06-02T..."
}
```

request.description:
Returns a single book by its 13-digit ISBN. Includes author, publisher, genre, all ratings, all comments, and a computed averageRating.

**Sprint 2 — Implemented ✅**

**Sample ISBNs to test:**
- Clean Code: `9780132350884`
- Deep Learning: `9780262035613`
- Kubernetes Up and Running: `9781492046530`
- Designing Data-Intensive Apps: `9781449373320`

**Expected response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "isbn": "9780132350884",
    "title": "Clean Code",
    "averageRating": 4.50,
    "ratings": [...],
    "comments": [...]
  }
}
```

**Expected response (404 Not Found):**
```json
{ "error": "Book with ISBN \"000\" not found." }
```

Tests that the API correctly returns 404 when an ISBN does not exist in the database.

**Expected response (404 Not Found):**
```json
{ "error": "Book with ISBN \"0000000000000\" not found." }
```

request.description:
Creates a new book record in the catalog.

Required: isbn, title, description, price, yearPublished, authorId, genreId, publisherId.
Optional: copiesSold (defaults to 0 — a new book hasn't sold any copies yet), coverImage.

**Sprint 3 — Implemented ✅**

Implemented by Francisco Sierra on the `Book-Details` branch (`create-book-endpoint`).

**Expected response (201 Created):**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": 31,
    "isbn": "9781234567890",
    "title": "New Tech Book",
    "price": 49.99,
    "yearPublished": 2026,
    "copiesSold": 0,
    "coverImage": null,
    "authorId": 1,
    "genreId": 1,
    "publisherId": 1,
    "author": { "id": 1, "firstName": "..." },
    "genre": { "id": 1, "name": "..." },
    "publisher": { "id": 1, "name": "..." }
  }
}
```

**Possible 400 errors:**
- A required field is missing/invalid (see the dedicated 400 test below).
- isbn already exists: `{ "error": "A book with isbn \"...\" already exists." }`
- authorId/genreId/publisherId doesn't exist: `{ "error": "No matching record(s) for: authorId 999." }`
